# Zalde Todo AI

> Fullstack AI-Powered Todo List & Productivity Suite with RAG Copilot, semantic search, and automated task breakdown.

Zalde Todo AI is a modern task management web application designed for individual and team productivity. It integrates artificial intelligence with PostgreSQL vector search (pgvector) to assist users with automated task breakdown, semantic querying of tasks, and collaborative workflows.

## Links

- [App Home](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/): Main application workspace, task boards, and AI copilot interface.
- [API Documentation](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/swagger): Interactive OpenAPI and RESTful API endpoints reference.
- [Sitemap](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap indexing all canonical routes and public pages.
- [Robots Configuration](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawler rules and sitemap directives for search engines and AI user-agents.

## Core Capabilities

- [Task Management](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/#tasks): Create, update, prioritize, and manage subtasks.
- [AI Breakdown](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/#ai-breakdown): Automated multi-step task decomposition with Gemini AI.
- [Semantic Search](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/#semantic-search): Natural language task search powered by pgvector embeddings.
- [Calendar Feeds](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/#calendar): Export live iCal (.ics) feeds for Google, Apple, and Outlook calendars.
- [Collaboration](https://todo-list-zalde.vercel.app/#collaboration): Real-time shared workspace and task discussion.
